cells.tense: You are doing this right now, and the pen is in your hand.
cells.ask: Go in with the plan you have, not the one you would have with another week. Bring the draft, the test, the safety plan as they stand tonight.
cells.core:
You have enough light for the next step and you are already taking it. The money is tight, the answer has not come, and neither of those has stopped your feet from moving. You are carrying something real, nobody is holding you up, and it holds anyway.

The strength here is not horsepower. It is the plain ability to keep your footing while the road stays mostly dark, and to trust the one lit step without demanding the rest. Practised well it looks like this: you make the call, keep the appointment, do the math, and hold something that would rather be dropped. It does not need a good morning to work. Feed it something small today.
cells.sheetLine: One lit step is enough, and you are already on it.
cells.verb: persisting through material pressure on your own resources
cells.place: moving through uncertainty with only enough light for the next step

cells.tense: You are already bracing at a future that has not happened and cannot be written in.
cells.ask: Ask for one thing you need this week — flatly, no case built first. A favor, an extension, a hand with the move. One ask, not the whole story.
cells.core:
You are carrying pre-emptively. Every version of this gets prepared for before it arrives — the money, the test, the conversation, the way it could all go — and the preparing has become the thing you are doing instead of the thing. The endurance is real, but it is being spent on loads that do not exist yet.

Giving and receiving have stopped running both ways. Everything moves out and holding harder feels like the only option left. It is not. One thing has to come back in, from a person, not from your own reserves. Ask for it plainly, without pre-paying for it first, and let it land.
cells.sheetLine: You are bracing so hard the help cannot land.

cells.tense: You are still at a door that is already behind you.
cells.ask: Tell one person what the last stretch was like, out loud, early, before you get strong about it. Let them hear it without letting them lift it.
cells.core:
Done well this is simple: you carry what needs carrying, you keep the appointment and do the math, and someone knows what it was like. The weight gets shared in words even when it is not shared in hands. That is the whole difference — holding a thing and being known to be holding it.

Here the second half is missing. You made it through something hard and filed it under ordinary, so no one has heard the number, or the night, or the part that took the most. Say it once, to one person, without asking them to pick anything up. No one is beside you at that door.
cells.sheetLine: You made it through and no one heard what it took.

cells.tense: You are writing this right now with the pen down and no claim on it.
cells.ask: Put the unpaid hour on the calendar with your own name on it. Not after things ease off — this week, in the books, as work.
cells.core:
Done well this is simple: you keep going and it is you doing the going. The month gets tight, the answer does not come, the ground shifts, and you are the one who holds — and you say so, to yourself first. The hoping is still there and it is still yours.

The doing is running and the saying is not. You call it getting by, or just what has to be done, and hand the credit to the situation. Name it once, out loud, where you can hear yourself do it. Say what has kept going and who kept it going.
cells.sheetLine: You are the one holding this, and you have not said so.

The sentence that serves me more than them would be 'you're holding without forcing,' since it flatters the card rather than describing a moment they'd recognise.
